hints.title: Graph Augmentation
hints.text: Each query adds a single directed edge. Because edges have unit weight and graph size n is small, breadth-first traversal can evaluate shortest paths directly.

hints.title: Incremental BFS Execution
hints.text: After adding each edge to the adjacency list, initialize distances to -1 and traverse from node 0.

hints.title: Early Termination
hints.text: Terminate queue processing as soon as node n - 1 is dequeued and record its level as the answer for that query.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: BFS runs after each edge insertion across at most n + q edges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs shortest path algorithms take O(n^3) per query which is excessive.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + q) memory maintains the evolving adjacency list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverages unweighted BFS property to compute query distances.
